assertions.assertion: A class implementing IClientStore is created with a constructor accepting IMongoDatabase
assertions.rationale: MongoClientStore : IClientStore has a constructor accepting IMongoDatabase and obtaining the 'clients' collection.

assertions.assertion: The FindClientByIdAsync method does NOT include a CancellationToken parameter (v7 target)
assertions.rationale: FindClientByIdAsync(string clientId) has no CancellationToken, matching the v7 interface.

assertions.assertion: Registration calls AddClientStore<T> where T is the custom store class
assertions.rationale: AddClientStore<MongoClientStore>() is called on the IdentityServer builder.

assertions.assertion: Registration calls AddInMemoryCaching() and AddClientStoreCache<T>() to wrap the custom store with caching
assertions.rationale: Both AddInMemoryCaching() and AddClientStoreCache<MongoClientStore>() are chained after the store registration.

assertions.assertion: ClientStoreExpiration is set to TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5) or equivalent 5-minute duration
assertions.rationale: options.Caching.ClientStoreExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5) is set in AddIdentityServer.
